$comment: Lead Finder data for this business type (ADR 0119; added 18 Nov 2026 so every business has it). Read by app/lead_finder/packdata.py. Every prospect in `fixture` is INVENTED: synthetic names, '+00' numbers (the reserved demo range), no real business. Who it looks for: small businesses and shop owners who need insurance or a business loan (shops, clinics, workshops, transport and service businesses). The Telugu words are drafts for a native reader. BFSI: this business type is banking, financial services and insurance. Any later calling in the 140 series (v1.1) has extra rules for BFSI, so v1.1 MUST re-check this pack before it is used for calls. Today nobody is ever called by the AI.

purpose.en: We help small businesses in your area with insurance and loans.
purpose.te: మీ ఏరియాలో చిన్న వ్యాపారాలకి మేము insurance, loans లో సహాయం చేస్తాం.

sells.en: What do you mainly need or work on now?
sells.te: మీరు ఇప్పుడు ముఖ్యంగా ఏ పని మీద ఉన్నారు, ఏం అవసరం?

price.en: What budget do you usually work with?
price.te: మీరు సాధారణంగా ఎంత budget తో చూస్తారు?

quantity.en: Roughly how many people or units is it for?
quantity.te: సుమారు ఎంత మందికి లేదా ఎన్ని units కి?

supplier.en: Who do you work with now?

timing.en: When would you want to start?
